prompt:
Design brief — your own take on this character. A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Oganesson (오가네손) itself — the sovereign of the Oganesson Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Age: about twenty — a fresh young-adult face; no facial lines.

You design her yourself: invent her face, eye colour, hairstyle, makeup, expression, pose and setting as a fresh, original take — do not follow any earlier design of this character. Her hair colour and costume are NOT free: take them from our designs below.

Style (fixed): A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish.

Inspiration only — her element: a synthetic superheavy element that exists for less than a millisecond — only a handful of atoms have ever been made, nobody has ever seen it: it flickers in and out of existence, its edges dissolve into light and scatter as it decays into lighter elements; by position it belongs to the noble-gas royalty (aloof, never mixing) yet is predicted to be a strange heavy solid. Palette: void black, deep indigo, pale violet-white decay glow, ghostly translucency, a hint of gold for royalty.

World (fixed): a prophesied kingdom that does not yet exist — the blank space beyond the last charted country on an ancient star-map: the final tile of a vast mosaic floor that ends in void, a half-formed ghost city flickering into being and dissolving again, towers of violet light and falling ash; an oracle's unfinished star-chart embroidered on her cloak, hems dissolving into drifting motes. Her costume and setting belong to this world.

Costume (choose one of ours, then add your own idea): pick ONE of these costume shapes from our set and keep its overall silhouette — 1) a long floor-length robe with a high collar, wide sleeves and a shoulder mantle — a tall, mysterious mage's silhouette; 2) a fitted breastplate and pauldrons above a gown skirt flaring to the floor — an elegant lady-knight silhouette; 3) a light breastplate and bracers with robe panels split from the waist — half armor, half robe; 4) large metal feathered wing ornaments spreading from the shoulders or back and a wing-shaped head ornament — the wings make the shape; 5) angular, spiked dark plate armor and a long cape with torn edges — a sharp, menacing silhouette; 6) a fur cloak, leather straps, minimal metal plates and bone and tooth ornaments — a rugged, wild warrior silhouette; 7) a long coat below the knees with epaulettes, a belt, gloves and tall boots — a crisp, commanding officer's silhouette; 8) a floor-length priestly vestment with gold-trimmed stoles and a tall head ornament — a long, devout silhouette; 9) a great crown and a fur-trimmed royal mantle over an ornate breastplate — a ceremonial, regal silhouette. Then add one signature idea of your own drawn from her element, built into the construction of the outfit itself rather than as a print or a loose accessory — e.g. plates or cloth layered like crystals, scales or flames, a hem or sleeve cut into a shape from her element. Build it in this world's materials and our colours below.

Costume colours (ours): void black, deep indigo, pale violet-white decay glow, ghostly translucency, a hint of gold for royalty.

Hair colour (fixed — ours): pale violet-white hair that dissolves into light at the ends. Keep exactly this hair colour; only the hairstyle is yours.

Exposure (fixed): bold — her outfit shows skin by design (a deep neckline, bare shoulders or arms, a high slit or short hem); intimate areas covered.

Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin — never a long face or a long, pointed or heavy jaw; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline and never lengthens her face. Her eyes stay at a natural open size — never squeezed into narrow slits.

Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

If you have already drawn a free design of her in this session, make this one clearly different — another face and hairstyle (the same hair colour), another costume shape with another signature idea, another pose and setting.

Write your own detailed image prompt from this brief, then draw it. One figure only, natural hands with five fingers; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Og) and atomic number (118) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.

Detailed design for this image:
Use costume shape 4: large metal feathered wing ornaments and a wing-shaped head ornament. Construct the wings as discontinuous, nested black crystalline segments held apart by pale violet decay light: a royal crest that is perpetually losing and regaining its outermost layer. Fitted indigo breastplate, bare upper arms, split short robe panels and tall armored boots. Give her a compact oval adult face, luminous ice-blue eyes and a pale violet-white high braided ponytail with airy curtain bangs. Curious, composed expression. Both bare human hands empty and visible, one relaxed near her chest, the other open beside her hip. She stands in a roofless prophecy hall beneath a bright violet dawn; its unfinished star mosaic disappears into distant mist.

generation.note: Generated once; no exposure-based regeneration. Original PNG is not committed.
